objectives.title: Verbalise provenance events
objectives.description: Convert structured process, file and network provenance records into consistent natural-language descriptions.
objectives.evidence: V1 and V2 verbalisers; 243,271 reconstructed events verbalised.

objectives.title: Generate frozen semantic embeddings
objectives.description: Encode descriptions with a frozen pretrained sentence encoder to obtain comparable 384-dimensional vectors.

objectives.title: Train a benign-only anomaly detector
objectives.description: Train an autoencoder on benign events only and flag unusually high reconstruction errors.
objectives.evidence: E2-A to E2-D and E5-A to E5-C autoencoders.

objectives.title: Evaluate detection on CICAPT-IIoT
objectives.description: Measure ranking and threshold-based detection against original and contextual annotations, with explicit operating-point analysis.
objectives.evidence: Single-seed results exist; independent scenario validation and multi-seed evidence do not.

objectives.title: Investigate mitigation recommendations
objectives.description: Develop evidence-grounded, human-reviewed response recommendations and evaluate mitigation separately from detection.
objectives.evidence: No mitigation framework or effectiveness evaluation exists yet.
